title: phosphosite-proximity: code and derived data for distance-to-annotated-residue features in yeast and human phosphosite-mutant screens

creators.name: Nguyen, Kyle
creators.affiliation: Human Biology, College of Natural Sciences, The University of Texas at Austin

description:
Code, derived cohorts and the numerical authority for an audit of the distance from a phosphosite to the nearest UniProt-annotated active or binding residue, evaluated against 163 alanine substitutions in 48 yeast proteins and 1,470 base-edited sites in 787 human proteins.

Contents include the offline source-to-cohort rebuild for the human arm, the frozen estimator and its protein-clustered bootstrap, the submission figure pipeline, a 161-check package verifier, and NUMBERS.md — the numerical authority, which records every reported value, what supersedes what, and the claims that were retracted during preparation.

The two source workbooks are not redistributed; the workflow retrieves them and verifies their hashes.
